Anya (SRE): quick real quick before i swap tonight — can we confirm the split of responsibilities so the incoming knows who to page?

Matt (Runtime): short version: infra/platform alerts -> SRE; model-serving, inference errors, model timeouts, KV cache correctness -> Runtime. If its a k8s/node/kernel issue (OOM, kubelet, networking) SRE first. If the user-facing generate API is returning bad output or 5xx from the model process -> Runtime.

Lina (oncall-sre): addendum: performance SLAs: if p95 is broken because of infra (host CPU/memory pressure, node flapping) -> SRE. If p95 broken due to model characteristics (huge seq lengths, model regressions) -> Runtime.

Jae (runtime-dev): practical heuristic we use: "Who can fix it without touching infra?" -> runtime. Otherwise -> SRE. For fuzzy cases (eg KV eviction causing backpressure) tag both and follow the joint incident runbook.

Anya (SRE): i'll paste a minimal handoff checklist below, please tweak and i'll include it in the shift note. need it short and copy/pastable.

Matt (Runtime): please do.

Anya (SRE): ```text
- current oncall: Anya (SRE)
- incoming: Matt (Runtime)
- known risk windows: rolling quantized-llama1 deploy @ 02:00 UTC (watch memory on a7 pool), embeddings throttling experiment ongoing -> potential queueing
- active alerts: infra: cluster-east CPU high (see #incidents link), runtime: intermittent 502s /v1/generate (sample traces)
- runbooks: infra OOM -> runbook/infra/oom, runtime 502s -> runbook/runtime/502-troubleshoot
- escalation: oncall -> oncall-leads -> eng director (sev1)
- pager policy: sev1 = pager + phone, sev2 = pager, sev3 = slack-only
- pager channel: #incidents
```

Jae (runtime-dev): edit suggestion: change "memory on a7 pool" -> "memory pressure on a7 GPU pool when quantized-llama1 runs with seq>4096" and add fallback: `llama1-int8@v2` in case we need immediate rollback.

Anya (SRE): updated. thanks.

Lina (oncall-sre): proposed compact incident defs to include in handoff so folks know when to page:
- Sev1: production-wide outage or >50% error rate across regions OR security/data-loss event -> page+call+exec notify
- Sev2: degraded customer experience (p95 >2x SLO for >15m or errors affecting subset of traffic) -> page
- Sev3: localized/minor issues, monitoring alerts, or noise -> slack only

Matt (Runtime): runtime examples to add: Sev1 = model serving stack returning 500s across routes; Sev2 = tail latency spikes above SLO on a subset of routes for >15m; Sev3 = single customer embed job failing due to malformed input.

Anya (SRE): i'll include contacts: infra leads = @lina @anya, runtime leads = @matt @jae. if both teams are involved follow joint runbook: https://our-runbooks.internal/joint-incident
